title: RVLRY: revised compact phone UX
summary: Updated after your screen-by-screen feedback: less copy, concrete team setup, tracker removed during play, category colors and results highlights.
body:
# Revised phone mockups

Your 21 October feedback has been incorporated. Open **JNAS → Media → DropBox → RVLRY-phone-flow-proposal.html** for the updated visual storyboard. Refresh or reopen the file if you have the earlier version open. The APK is unchanged.

Kestrel provides this companion review and response form; the styled mockups remain in the HTML file.

| Screen | Updated proposal |
| --- | --- |
| 1. Saved game | Inside the selected game, after the hub. Save date/time, useful context, Resume and Start new game. Redundant save explanations removed. |
| 2. Setup | Save team advances to the next team. After the final team, Review teams then Start game. Editable sample fields demonstrate the interaction. |
| 3. Handoff | Keep I'm Maya — ready. Remove the next-up paragraph and repeated participant explanation. |
| 4. Playing | Remove the tracker. Compact game mark and round in header, larger timer, five recent words, large bottom actions. Category-colored clue panel with its text label. |
| 5. Turn recap | Score and word list, followed by Pass phone to Leo. Remove redundant finished-turn and next-team explanations. |
| 6. Round complete | Title, standings and handoff button. Remove explanatory paragraphs and next-round bubble. |
| 7. Paused | Take your time, compact presenter/time/score summary, existing buttons. Remove other body copy. |
| 8. Results | Standings plus best turn and most skips highlights. Remove obvious game-finished and replay explanations. |

## Settled direction
Compact two-level tracker between turns; numbered teams and round segments. No whole-game grid. Tight vertical grouping, communicate each fact once, and aim for one screen without internal scrollbars at normal sizes. Long lists, large accessibility text and keyboards may need controlled scrolling.

## Category colors
Proposed: Who = lilac, What = green, Where = blue. Text labels remain. The mockup cycles category colors to demonstrate them; the live game's current category-per-turn rule is unchanged.

## Results highlights
Best turn: player, team and points. Most skips: player, team and total skip actions over their turns. Ties should show shared leaders. These are illustrative design values, not implemented statistics yet.

The sample layouts and setup transitions were checked at 412px and 360px widths. This is a revised design proposal, not a new APK. Answer below if anything still needs changing. Submitting stores feedback and does not automatically start an agent.

questions.label: What still needs changing in these revised mockups? Mention the screen number where useful.
